style: Style: stylized low-poly 3D render, soft rounded shapes, strong readable silhouettes, warm earthy palette with rust-red tribal banners, hand-painted textures, isometric three-quarter top-down view from the exact same camera angle in every quadrant, light from top-left, each building sitting on its own small round patch of dirt and grass.
background: Background: flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere, no gradients, no shadows on the background, no text, no numbers, no labels, no borders, no grid lines, no people, no animals.
